robot_description2: An emissary from another reality, nearly identical to our own, but fundamentally different.  Piano heralds from a world where Dr. Wily created her instead of creating Disco, and one where he paid the ultimate price for his hubris.  Why she has come here to The Prototype is unknown, but with her power level being so high and her arsenal being so varied, it is clear that she poses a serious threat.  Take caution when engaging with this robot.
robot_quotes_start: I am not designed for confrontation, but I will proceed as instructed.
robot_quotes_taunt: I am not equipped for taunting. However, your performance is below projected standards.
robot_quotes_victory: This concludes the encounter. Thank you for your participation.
robot_quotes_defeat: Hmm. I have fallen below acceptable performance thresholds.
